name: Optimal Steps (OSS)
plain: Hard-coded flow-range schedules for FLUX (10 steps), Wan (20) and Chroma (40), from the source named in the header comment (bebebe666/OptimalSteps). Other step counts use the same log-linear resample as AYS. The tables are absolute sigmas and the node takes no model input, so the loaded model's shift setting has no effect on them.
math:
Table τ for model_type. If steps+1 ≠ len(τ): σ = loglinear_interp(τ, steps+1).
Keep last round(steps·denoise)+1; last forced to 0.
label: from code
surprise: The Wan table spends 13 of its 20 steps between 1.0 and 0.946 and the table's first value is 1.0, so high noise gets most of the budget (nodes_optimalsteps.py:25).
